items.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon with $3/$15 per million tokens and top coding benchmarks
items.summary: Gemini 4 Neon fills the gap between Carbon and Hydrogen with a 1M-token context window, four thinking levels and a cyber defense variant. Ranked #1 on Coding Agent Index and AutomationBench at 32% lower cost per task than Carbon.
items.why: Neon gives developers a frontier-tier model priced between Carbon and Hydrogen, strengthening Google's position against Claude Fable 5.2 and GPT-6.2 Astra. Its Orchestrator mode in Antigravity signals Google's push toward multi-agent coding workflows.

items.headline: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 per share, trading begins today on Nasdaq under ticker ANT
items.summary: Anthropic priced 980M Class A shares at $83, above the $70-$78 range. Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are leading. Underwriters have a 30-day option on 147M additional shares. Closing expected November 20.

items.headline: OpenAI says AI coding agents now run 5.7 workdays per researcher, up 11x since earlier this year
items.summary: Updated research acceleration report shows median researcher spends about $2,400 per day on agent API use. Agentic AI spend reached roughly 2x researchers' non-equity pay. Pretraining teams average 8 agent workdays per researcher.

items.headline: OpenAI models cut its chip area by 13% and achieved up to 14% PPA gains on an AMD GPU
items.summary: GPT models redesigned standard cells in OpenAI's custom inference chip, cutting vector unit area by 13%. AMD reported up to 14% PPA improvements on a flagship GPU. Synopsys is building GPT-Synopsys for EDA tools.

items.headline: Google launches Genie 4 world model with mid-session editing and native audio for browser worlds
items.summary: Genie 4 generates interactive browser-based worlds with real-time text editing and adaptive audio. Genie 3 extends to 3-minute sessions. Available to AI Ultra subscribers with a waitlist for Pro.

items.headline: OpenAI details layered safety framework with a Control Room that halts model output in 35 seconds
items.summary: New post describes defense-in-depth approach across research, internal and external deployment. A central Control Room can halt any model output within 35 seconds. Any employee can flag misalignment for possible public disclosure.

items.headline: Gemini app comes to Android Go edition phones with Live, camera help and image creation
items.summary: Google re-architected Gemini for lower-memory devices. Users get Gemini Live in 45+ languages, camera-based help for notes and forms, and Nano Banana image creation. Preloaded on upcoming Transsion devices.

items.headline: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 hit elevated errors for about 15 minutes, now resolved
items.summary: Elevated error rates affected Claude's flagship models from 08:56 to 09:11 UTC on November 19. The incident is now resolved.

items.headline: Claude Meetings auto-join briefly limited on the Team plan, now restored
items.summary: Claude Meetings (beta) auto-join was limited for Team plan users. The feature is now restored, with full rollout to Team customers expected soon.
